Why does this repository qualify?: PetWaymark is a free, neutral open-source dog/cat travel research tool with a deterministic offline engine, bilingual checklists and official-source draft evidence for six international directions. Code is Apache-2.0; curated data is CC BY 4.0. All 15 rules are drafts; verified routes and documented independent adoption are zero. Future reuse could reduce duplicated rule-checking work; no external integration is claimed.
How will you use API credits for your pr: Proposed use: draft official-source change summaries, suggest regression cases and assist issue triage and release notes. A maintainer would review every output; AI would never verify legal rules or confirm travel. No API runtime dependency exists today. Organization ID, usage estimates and budget caps remain to be filled before submission.
Anything else we should know?: v0.1.0 is a research preview. Public commits 9965c85 and c6722c2 have successful hosted CI; the baseline has 200 Python tests, 48 overlapping synthetic audit cases and 22 fixed bilingual demo examples. Week 12 separates maintenance, developer self-use, synthetic tests and independent adoption (0). Actual qualified independent review and voluntary trials remain missing. Planning weeks are task stages, not elapsed weeks. No booking, orders or live capacity.
